M3 is defined by one terminal inventory predicate: ender_eye>=12 (the item id is ender_eye, display 'Eye of Ender'; eye_of_ender is the thrown projectile entity and must not be used). Crafting 12 eyes needs 12 ender_pearl plus 12 blaze_powder, so M3 requires BOTH a hostile-mob difficulty change (enderman drops) and Nether access (blaze rods). No run-scoped executable gate is wired for M3 yet.
M4 is the Ender Dragon milestone: reaching and killing the dragon in minecraft:the_end. Its enabling items (ender_eye x12) belong to M3. No run-scoped M4 artifact gate is wired yet.
